feature: Add smooth CSS animations and neon visual effects

existing_animations: winning-pulse keyframe (box-shadow pulse on .cell.winning, infinite alternate)
gaps_requiring_new_work: No mark-appear animation when X/O is placed (cells appear instantaneously)
No player-aware neon glow on empty cell hover (only scale transform + bg color)
No board entrance animation on page load
No prefers-reduced-motion media query anywhere in CSS
Button focus-visible uses only box-shadow — no outline neon border
Scoreboard active-player transition lacks transform for subtle scale emphasis
already_satisfied: winning-pulse keyframe satisfies the pulsing neon glow on .winning cells
turn-indicator transitions (border-color/box-shadow) handle smooth active-player shift
score-card transitions (border-color/box-shadow) enable smooth highlight slide
btn-primary:hover has neon box-shadow glow — minor enhancement only needed
analysis.css_sibling_strategy: The HTML order <div.turn-indicator.is-x> precedes <div.board> inside .game-container, enabling the CSS general sibling combinator (.turn-indicator.is-x ~ .board .cell:not(.taken):hover) to target empty cell hover color based on whose turn it is — pure CSS, zero JS changes.

implementation_plan.description: Add @keyframes mark-appear for cell mark placement animation. Define a spring-style entry (scale 0→1, rotate -15deg→0deg, opacity 0→1). Add display:inline-block to .cell.x-piece::after and .cell.o-piece::after so transforms apply to the pseudo-element. Wire animation: mark-appear 0.3s cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) forwards to both pseudo-elements.

Enhance the existing winning-pulse @keyframes to also animate transform: scale() between 1.0 and 1.03 alongside the existing box-shadow oscillation, making the winning cells feel more alive without changing their layout flow.

Add player-aware hover glow on empty cells using CSS sibling combinator. Two new rule sets: .turn-indicator.is-x ~ .board .cell:not(.taken):hover adds cyan box-shadow; .turn-indicator.is-o ~ .board .cell:not(.taken):hover adds magenta box-shadow. No JS changes required.

Enhance scoreboard active-player indicator: add transform to the .score-card transition property list (transform 0.2s ease) and add transform: scale(1.04) to .score-card.active-player so the active card gently grows. This creates a smooth slide-like emphasis effect between X and O cards.

Improve button focus/hover neon states. For .btn:focus-visible, supplement the existing box-shadow with outline: 2px solid and the matching glow color so keyboard focus is unambiguously neon. Ensure .btn-ghost:hover gains a subtle neon border glow matching the color-muted palette. Keep existing .btn-primary:hover glow but strengthen slightly.

Add @keyframes board-enter (translateY(24px) scale(0.97) opacity:0 → translateY(0) scale(1) opacity:1) and apply animation: board-enter 0.5s ease-out both to the .board selector. This gives a subtle slide-up + scale entrance on first paint.

Add @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) block as the final section of the stylesheet. Inside it: set animation: none !important on .board, .cell.winning, .cell.x-piece::after, .cell.o-piece::after; set transition-duration: 0.01ms !important on .cell, .turn-indicator, .score-card, .btn, .status-message to preserve logical state changes without motion.

Run the full existing test suite (npm test) and Playwright E2E tests (npx playwright test) to confirm all CSS changes are additive and no JS behavior is broken. Add targeted Playwright tests for animation CSS properties.

changes.name: @keyframes mark-appear
changes.css: @keyframes mark-appear { from { display: inline-block; transform: scale(0) rotate(-15deg); opacity: 0; } to { transform: scale(1) rotate(0deg); opacity: 1; } }
changes.rationale: Spring-curve entry via cubic-bezier(0.34, 1.56, 0.64, 1) gives an organic 'pop' without JS

changes.name: @keyframes board-enter
changes.css: @keyframes board-enter { from { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(24px) scale(0.97); } to { opacity: 1; transform: translateY(0) scale(1); } }
changes.rationale: Subtle lift-in on first paint, plays once with fill-mode: both

changes.name: @keyframes winning-pulse (enhancement)
changes.from: @keyframes winning-pulse { from { box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,230,0,0.18), 0 0 8px var(--color-win-glow); } to   { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,230,0,0.30), 0 0 20px var(--color-win-glow); } }
changes.to: @keyframes winning-pulse { from { box-shadow: inset 0 0 24px rgba(255,230,0,0.18), 0 0 8px var(--color-win-glow); transform: scale(1.0); } to   { box-shadow: inset 0 0 40px rgba(255,230,0,0.30), 0 0 20px var(--color-win-glow); transform: scale(1.03); } }
changes.rationale: Adds micro-scale pulse to complement box-shadow oscillation
Required for CSS transform to apply to a pseudo-element
Triggers once per mark placement; forwards keeps the end state
Cyan glow when it is X's turn — pure CSS sibling combinator, no JS
Magenta glow when it is O's turn

changes.to: transition: border-color 0.2s ease, box-shadow 0.2s ease, transform 0.2s ease;
changes.rationale: Enables animated scale on active-player toggle
Active card gently enlarges, creating perceivable 'slide-highlight' without a literal moving element

changes.to: outline: 2px solid var(--color-x); outline-offset: 3px; box-shadow: 0 0 0 4px var(--color-x-glow), 0 0 12px var(--color-x-glow);
changes.rationale: Combines outline (neon border) + glow box-shadow for unmistakable keyboard focus
Subtle neon border-echo on the ghost button's hover
One-shot entrance on page load; fill-mode both prevents flash-of-invisible

file_changes.section: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) — NEW block at end of stylesheet

changes.description: Disable all keyframe animations on affected elements
Minimize transition durations to near-zero (logical state still changes, just instantly)

css_architecture_notes.sibling_combinator_trick: The .turn-indicator.is-x ~ .board CSS sibling selector pattern works because game.js already toggles is-x/is-o classes on #turnIndicator (via updateTurnIndicator()), and .board is a subsequent sibling in the DOM. This gives player-aware hover glow with zero new JavaScript.
css_architecture_notes.pseudo_element_animation: Animating ::after requires display:inline-block or display:block on the pseudo-element so CSS transforms apply. The font-size and color are inherited from the parent .cell, so adding display:inline-block is safe.
css_architecture_notes.transform_on_winning_cells: Adding transform:scale() to the winning-pulse keyframe works because .cell already has position:relative and overflow:hidden, preventing layout interference.
css_architecture_notes.animation_fill_mode_both: board-enter uses fill-mode:both so the element starts invisible before the animation fires (prevents FOUC on slow paints).

Computed style check: verify .turn-indicator.is-o ~ .board .cell:not(.taken):hover has magenta box-shadow

rollback_plan: All changes are confined to the embedded <style> block in index.html. No new files are created. No JS logic, package.json, or test infrastructure changes are made. Rollback options: (1) git checkout feature/css-animations-neon-effects -- index.html to restore prior state; (2) git revert HEAD if changes are already committed; (3) if partially through implementation, git diff index.html shows exactly what changed for surgical manual revert. No database, API, or dependency changes to unwind.

risk_assessment.risk: transform on .cell.winning breaking layout (overflow:hidden clips scale)
risk_assessment.mitigation: Keep scale factor small (1.03); test at all three viewport breakpoints; use margin-compensated scale if clipping is observed

risk_assessment.risk: Sibling combinator (.turn-indicator.is-x ~ .board) failing if DOM order changes
risk_assessment.mitigation: DOM order is static HTML; document the dependency in a CSS comment so future refactors are aware

risk_assessment.risk: display:inline-block on ::after disrupting cell text layout
risk_assessment.mitigation: Cell uses flexbox centering which handles inline-block children; no fixed-height constraint on ::after

risk_assessment.risk: Board entrance animation causing layout shift (CLS) on slow connections
risk_assessment.mitigation: fill-mode:both keeps the element invisible until animation starts, preventing reflow; translateY(24px) is a compositor-only property
